```sql

RETURNS TABLE (
    user_id INT,
    timestamp DATETIME2(10, 0, 0),
    created_at DATETIME64(15, 0, 0) AS integer
)
BEGIN
    SELECT * FROM users WHERE creationDate >= now() AND 
       created_at < now();
END;
```
